summary: Phase S1 Green evidence — direct coder delegation. lib/observed-routing.mjs implements the seven-function contract (extractObservedRouting, classifyObservedRouting, runtimeModelStrict, computeRoleDefinitionHash, resolveStrict, classifyAgentFile, buildReceipt) per the JSDoc-style header in tests/observed-routing.test.mjs; the parent-fallback path is removed from runtimeModel and an absent child pin is now a structured `undeclared_child_pin` error naming the role. extensions/measure-harness/index.ts extends the TaskReceipt interface with requestedModel/observedModel/observedAt/roleDefinitionHash/routingClassification, computes roleDefinitionHash from the parsed role body before spawn, observes the served model via extractObservedRouting on the captured JSON event stream, classifies via classifyObservedRouting, and writes all five new fields to the receipt. The failed-detection logic now also fails the task when routingClassification.class === 'unverified_routing'. All 10 observed-routing tests pass (was 0/10 in Red). The 9 other shipped test files continue to pass (78/78 in test:shipped). npm test exits 1 with 88 pass / 14 fail — the 14 failures are all from tests/sprint-state-machine.test.mjs (a parallel-track Red file committed to the repo HEAD during this session by a parallel agent on `controlled_harness_evolution_20260714` Phase S2; that file is correctly classified as track-red by tests/.track-red-files.txt and is therefore excluded from the shipped partition). npm run parity exits 1 with 2 unmapped agents (coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast and measure-adversarial-testing — unchanged from Red; recorded here as NF-1 for Phase 2 reconciliation). npm run check exits 0 (TypeScript clean). No production modules outside the contract surface were touched.

The partition is therefore 9 shipped / 2 track-red / 0 unclassified (not 9 / 1 / 0 as the task template expected). The shipped gate still exits 0, and the 14 sprint-state-machine failures are correctly excluded from the shipped partition by the classifier — no action required for Phase S1. The new observed-routing.test.mjs stays in track-red at this commit and is removed at S1 acceptance (Phase 1 closeout), per the strategy §Phase 1 handoff.

files_modified: extensions/measure-harness/index.ts (extended TaskReceipt interface with requestedModel/observedModel/observedAt/roleDefinitionHash/routingClassification; wired observed-routing helpers into the task handler; removed parent-fallback from runtimeModel; added routingFailure to the failed-detection logic)
contracts_implemented: lib/observed-routing.mjs: extractObservedRouting(events) walks the JSON event stream and returns the first message_start.message.model, or undefined; classifyObservedRouting(pin, observedModel) returns {class: 'verified_routing'} | {class: 'unverified_routing', reason: 'observed_routing_mismatch', requestedModel, observedModel} | {class: 'unverified_routing', reason: 'observed_routing_unobservable'}; runtimeModelStrict(agent) returns {model} | {error: {class: 'undeclared_child_pin', role}} — NEVER falls back to a parent model; computeRoleDefinitionHash(systemPrompt) returns sha256(systemPrompt.trim()); resolveStrict(requestedModel, observedModel) returns strict equality after MODEL_MAP[requestedModel] resolution (no alias widening); classifyAgentFile(filePath, lstat) returns {class: 'symlinked_agent_file', path} on symlink, null otherwise; buildReceipt({pin, roleDefinition, promptBody, events}) composes the structured receipt with requestedModel/observedModel/roleDefinitionHash/promptHash/failureClassification/verifiedRouting — byte-identical across repeated calls.

extensions/measure-harness/index.ts: TaskReceipt interface extended with requestedModel?, observedModel?, observedAt?, roleDefinitionHash?, routingClassification?; runtimeModel(agent) is now a strict wrapper around runtimeModelStrict(agent).model — the prior parent-fallback is removed; the task handler computes roleDefinitionHash via computeRoleDefinitionHash(child.systemPrompt), observes the served model via extractObservedRouting(events), classifies via classifyObservedRouting(modelRef, observedModel), captures observedAt from the first message_start.message.timestamp, and writes all five new fields to the receipt; the failed-detection logic includes routingClassification.class === 'unverified_routing' so the task fails closed when observed routing contradicts the pin or is unobservable.

test_inventory.name: live-behavior — matching observation: first message_start.model === pin → observedModel === pin, no failureClassification
live-behavior — contradicting observation: observed ≠ pin → failureClassification === observed_routing_mismatch
live-behavior — unobservable routing: no message_start.model → failureClassification === observed_routing_unobservable
live-behavior — undeclared pin (parent-fallback removed): runtimeModelStrict returns undeclared_child_pin error
live-behavior — roleDefinitionHash on receipt: SHA-256 of role body, distinct from promptHash when continuation present
fail-closed — three distinct failure classifications: emitted as distinct {class, reason} findings (A7 defense)
A3 probe — verified-counter: status is {class, reason}, never a bare integer
A7 probe — no widening of accepted divergence: strict equality after MODEL_MAP resolution
A8 probe — symlink rejection: agent file resolved through symlink → {class: 'symlinked_agent_file', path}
deterministic output: two receipt writes for the same fixture invocation produce byte-identical stable fields
